title: Environmental-system employees protest for pay increases

occurrence.summary: BTA and the Environment Ministry confirm a protest and meeting with the minister on 5 December.

location.summary: Sofia intersection; KNSB claims additional simultaneous actions in other cities but its body was not retrieved.

size.summary: Official ministry account describes dozens in Sofia; organizer claims of hundreds across multiple cities are search-only. >=50 simultaneous attendees remains unverified.

demand.summary: Workers asked for a 30% base-pay increase retroactive to 1 November and higher allocations in the 2025 budget.

state_target.summary: Demand directed to the Environment Ministry/state budget; minister met worker representatives.

end.summary: Minister meeting is reported; duration and final resolution unknown.

open_questions: Did at least 50 participate simultaneously in Sofia or any separately documented city, and which cities had actual same-time actions? Is this a distinct continuation of the October pay campaign?

title: Livestock owners protest outside Council of Ministers over animal-disease response

occurrence.summary: NOVA reports a gathering/protest outside the Council of Ministers.

location.summary: Outside the Council of Ministers in Sofia.

demand.summary: Livestock owners sought adequate measures for affected animals and dialogue with state authorities.

state_target.summary: Participants gathered at the government building and addressed state measures; representatives also sought meetings with senior state officials.

open_questions: How many livestock owners gathered simultaneously, and what concrete state measure did they demand or obtain?

title: Taxi drivers protest in Sofia seeking parliamentary action on insurance premiums

occurrence.summary: BNT and NOVA post-event reports confirm a taxi-driver protest in Sofia and a protest note delivered to parliament.

location.summary: Central Sofia, including Battenberg Square and the parliament/insurers association route.

size.summary: No number of participants or vehicles reported in the opened post-event accounts.

demand.summary: Drivers demanded parliamentary action limiting premium increases and changing the insurance-price methodology until legislation is changed.

state_target.summary: Demand explicitly asks the National Assembly to adopt a resolution; competition authority investigation is separately reported.

end.summary: Post-event reports describe a protest note and procession; exact end time unknown. This is a separate December gathering in an ongoing insurance dispute, not merged with November.

open_questions: How many taxi drivers participated in the Sofia gathering, and what was its end/outcome relative to the November 20 action?

title: Gabrovo residents protest prolonged power outages and petition for utility-license revocation

occurrence.summary: BNR reports an actual protest at the utility office; BNT confirms Gabrovo protest on the fourth day of outages.

size.summary: BNR says dozens; this does not verify 50 or more.

demand.summary: Residents collected signatures asking KEVR to revoke the utility’s licence over service failures.

state_target.summary: Demand directly targets state energy regulator KEVR.

open_questions: Did at least 50 residents gather simultaneously in Gabrovo, and did KEVR respond to the license-revocation petition?

title: Troyan residents protest prolonged electricity outage outside utility office

occurrence.summary: BNT confirms a protest in Troyan during the fourth day without electricity.

demand.summary: Residents sought answers from the utility director; no direct government-policy demand is shown.

state_target.summary: The reported immediate target was the utility company; state-directed demand remains unproven.

open_questions: Did the Troyan gathering reach 50 simultaneous participants, and is any state-directed demand documented beyond a request for answers from the utility?

title: Lovech-village residents and mayors block highway after prolonged outage

occurrence.summary: BNT reports residents and local mayors blocked the Sofia–Varna road for about an hour.

location.summary: Road near Ablanitsa, Lovech municipality, on Sofia–Varna route.

demand.summary: Participants complained that paying customers remained without power for days and sought state compensation and grid investment.

state_target.summary: State compensation and grid investment are reported demands; utility-service complaints are also directed to the provider.

date.summary: 30 December 2024; article describes six days without power.

end.summary: Road block reportedly lasted about one hour.

open_questions: What was the simultaneous attendance at the Lovech-area road block, and which state authority received the reported compensation/grid-investment demand?

title: Farmers’ indefinite road protest near Sigmen over animal disease

occurrence.summary: BNR and BTA report a road protest near Sigmen on 30 December.

size.summary: BTA and BNR participant estimates conflict (around 30 versus above 50); threshold is unresolved.

demand.summary: Farmers protested an unresolved animal-disease situation; exact demands and responsible state authority need review.

state_target.summary: Animal-health response concerns public authorities, but the opened reports do not establish a precise collective state-directed demand.

end.summary: BNR reports the protest ended for now and a meeting was planned for the next day; publication sequence/time conflicts with the initial reports, so exact chronology is unresolved.

open_questions: Which contemporaneous count is supported (BNR above 50 versus BTA around 30), what remedy did farmers demand from authorities, and when did this action begin/end?
